name: Create custom profile
description: Create custom profile Creates a DLP custom profile. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/custom
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/custom
Creates a DLP custom profile.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — A new profile to create.

name: Create predefined profile
description: Create predefined profile Creates a DLP predefined profile. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/predefined
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/predefined
Creates a DLP predefined profile. Only supports enabling/disabling entries.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — Predefined profiles can not be created. This endpoint will only update an existing predefined profiles settings.

name: Create predefined profile
description: Create predefined profile This is similar to `update_predefined` but only returns entries that are enabled. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/predefined/{profile_id}/config
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/predefined/{profile_id}/config
This is similar to `update_predefined` but only returns entries that are enabled. This is needed for our terraform API Creates a DLP predefined profile. Only supports enabling/disabling entries.
Required: account_id (path); profile_id (path); body (body) — Predefined profiles can not be created. This endpoint will only update an existing predefined profiles settings.

name: Delete custom profile
description: Delete custom profile Deletes a DLP custom profile. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/custom/{profile_id}

name: Delete predefined profile
description: Delete predefined profile This is a no-op as predefined profiles can't be deleted but is needed for our generated terraform API. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/predefined/{profile_id}

name: Get custom profile
description: Get custom profile Fetches a custom DLP profile by id. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/custom/{profile_id}

name: Get DLP Profile
description: Get DLP Profile Fetches a DLP profile by ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/{profile_id}

name: Get predefined profile
description: Get predefined profile Fetches a predefined DLP profile by id. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/predefined/{profile_id}

name: Get predefined profile config
description: Get predefined profile config This is similar to `get_predefined` but only returns entries that are enabled. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/predefined/{profile_id}/config
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/predefined/{profile_id}/config
This is similar to `get_predefined` but only returns entries that are enabled. This is needed for our terraform API Fetches a predefined DLP profile by id.
Required: account_id (path); profile_id (path)

name: List all custom profiles
description: List all custom profiles Lists all DLP custom profiles in an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/custom
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/custom
Lists all DLP custom profiles in an account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: List all profiles
description: List all profiles Lists all DLP profiles in an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles
Lists all DLP profiles in an account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: all (query) — Return all profiles, including those that current account does not have access to.

name: Update custom profile
description: Update custom profile Updates a DLP custom profile. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/custom/{profile_id}

name: Update predefined profile
description: Update predefined profile Updates a DLP predefined profile. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/predefined/{profile_id}

name: Update predefined profile config
description: Update predefined profile config This is similar to `update_predefined` but only returns entries that are enabled. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/predefined/{profile_id}/config
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/profiles/predefined/{profile_id}/config
This is similar to `update_predefined` but only returns entries that are enabled. This is needed for our terraform API Updates a DLP predefined profile. Only supports enabling/disabling entries.
Required: account_id (path); profile_id (path); body (body) — The updated parameters for the predefined profile.
